evidence.reason: At the pinned tip the ownership check and the git removal still use raw opts.path; canonicalPath is computed only after the check and is not passed to git. If opts.path is relative, isInsideRoot resolves it against the process cwd while git -C repoRoot resolves the same string against repoRoot, so the checked and removed locations can differ. The registry comparison now uses canonicalPath, so that part is addressed, but the ownership/removal path mismatch remains.
